The Petitioner is entitled to reimbursement of the fee paid for filing the Petition and publication expenses incurred 101. We have considered the Petitioner’s submissions and perused Regulation 99 of the 2024 Tariff Regulations. In view of the explicit provision made under Regulation 99 of the 2024 Tariff Regulations, we permit the Petitioner, i.e., PGCIL, to bear the fees and charges expenses of CTUIL and recover the same as additional O&M Expenses through a separate Petition until such regulation is notified and issued by the Commission. 108. MPPMCL has submitted that the contentions of the Petitioner regarding the security expenses, consequential IWC, insurance expenses and capital cost are premature and unwarranted as the 2019 and 2024 Tariff Regulations, do not allow the same. Further, MPPMCL has submitted that the Petitioner has filed Petition No. 45/MP/2024 before the Commission for recovery of the capital spares and IWC, therefore, the Petitioner may not be allowed to seek any claims from the Commission which are not included in the present Petition, therefore, the Petitioner’s request of filing a separate Petition for claiming the capital spares is infructuous and is denied as the same is already sub-judice before the Commission in Petition No. 45/MP/2024. - a) The trued-up AFC claimed by the Petitioner and approved in the instant order for 116.
